content:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary rollout id=canary-2026-03-15-12 detected 5xx spike (rate 12%). Auto-rollback started but timed out after 60s. Canary pods partially terminated; controller reports mismatch. Canary still serving ~8% traffic.
jen_oncall: Oncall Jen here, grabbing pager. Is there known customer-facing impact? :rotating_light:
sam: I'm seeing 502/504s from /v1/generate in logs correlated with canary request-id. Rate up since 12:33 UTC. No DB errors.
priya_sre: quick check -> LB still has endpoints with label canary=active. Controller failed to remove due to SIGKILL on rollout job. Likely orphaned endpoints.
irene: ok, priority is to stop customers hitting canary. Can we toggle the kill-switch flag for the feature? Which flag controls routing?
priya_sre: flag is `routing.use_canary_variant`. Flip to false will route 100% to stable.
jen_oncall: flipping now via flags service
jen_oncall: ```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/routing.use_canary_variant -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"value":false}'
```
jen_oncall: done — flag set to false. Waiting for rollout of flag (policy 30s). :hourglass:
mike: I'm also patching the service selector to remove canary label as a belt-and-suspenders measure
mike: ```bash
kubectl -n inference patch svc inference-gateway -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"canary":"stable"}}}'
```
sam: after flag flip, traffic to canary dropped from ~8% to 0.6% in the last 20s, errors trending down.
priya_sre: good. Next step: manual rollback of the failed canary release to avoid reconciliation flapping.
priya_sre: will run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=156`
priya_sre: ```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=156
```
irene: i'll trigger smoke tests against stable now (health, sample gen, latency)
irene: smoke suite start -> https://ci.internal/smoke/12345
irene: smoke tests: 3/3 pass, p95 latency back to baseline.
customer_ops: heads-up sent to impacted customers: we detected increased error rates between 12:33-12:38 UTC, mitigated, and monitoring now stable. Support doc link included. :white_check_mark:
jen_oncall: Verified stable is healthy, no ongoing errors for 3 minutes. Marking incident mitigated. Will follow up with postmortem and action items (ensure controller rollback job has retry/backoff).
sam: note: controllers should handle SIGTERM more gracefully; file issue with eng-runtime.
jen_oncall: creating incident ticket and assigning leads. 
deploy-bot: Incident 2167891234 status -> mitigated. Notifications to #incident-ops and oncall teams dispatched.
jen_oncall: closing thread here, will reopen if anomalies reappear. Thanks all. :pray:
